published_title: Lobotomy AKA The Deck AKA Broken AKA NPE
description:
I know a few people have run this deck, but I think I might have been the first to have it go undefeated at states...  I think Michael Richards helped me made it a little stronger as well...

It was fun to play and got tons of props from people who played against it and onlookers...

Enjoy!!!
strategy:
First turn:

Activate nothing, use insurrection to pull CC docking bay… Deploy lobot for free…  Play Computer Interface to draw 3… repeat, and if you have only computer interfaces left, leave them in reserve… make sure to get all of your cards to your hand and all of your computer interfaces in your hand to the used pile…

Deploy all 7 systems, all hoth sites (in this order Med Lab, War Room, Docking bay, generators, 4th marker), deploy tigrin to the med lab (free), kal to the war room (free), and phlyo to the docking bay (free)…  Put EBO down, then deploy all nabbo fighter for free (-1 from EBO), Put down goo nee tay, cover up their force Icons on endor w/ strike planning, so they don’t activate them… Move phylo to CC docking bay if lobot is still there… Grin, then say “your turn”

Opponents turn:

After they activate, take an action… drop 4 lobots to force pile using yoda stew…  Wait for them to decide what to do…  remember goo nee tay, and that since you occupy coruscant, all of their imperials deploy for +2, and if they go to beat on lobot, it takes +1 there too…  you can use it can wait to bounce a card…  usually better to bounce space, but you have to decide… you will still have one force to barrier, and last ditch effort, a houjix…  wait for them to finish, and grin…

2nd turn:

Activiate (usually down to your barrier, but if they do knock you off of CC, activate all you can to satisfy battle plan, and perhaps have enough to draw your yoda’s stew (only if you have to pay to drain) or barrier…  Drain them… (28 total if they didn’t stop any, 27 in space and 1 on CC)  Use tibrin’s game text to trade the remaining 3 lobots for the it can wait in used pile (or perhaps houjix if you won’t have enough force to play it can wait), If necessary,  move kal to docking bay and tigrin to war room…  You can draw if you need to, to swap w/ tibrin again… if you draw computer interfaces, you can get them back to your life force…

Opponents turn… much the same as last one… just evade all you can…  remember that the card you bounced, will be coming back for free, so it’s best to bounce it again…

3rd turn:

Drain…  if the game isn’t over (which it usually is), use tibrin to trade if you have the extra 3 force…  but usually it’s over by now…

What kills the deck:

Monnok…  If they start crush, you are in for a loss…

2 shields and a card… the one that pulls immediate effects and the shield that lets them to play them for free…  they pull there will be hell to pay, and then grab CI (V)… you are in for a loss

Not getting a Lobot or Computer interface opening hand…

Running out of computer interfaces as you draw… not likely but possible…

Extra Special thanks to Rogue4 for sharing the engine! :D

Hope you enjoyed it…:D

DanzBorin (aka Rob)
notes: Posted 'Throne Room' (starting site) dested Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room, the Light starting site used with HFTMF and Insurrection (cf. icebreath's gpn-5700).
Posted 'Naboo Fighters x7' dested Naboo Defense Fighter (the strategy deploys them free with EBO); Bravo Fighter is the other non-unique Naboo starfighter.

Original-era (V): Tigran Jamiro (V) (VS4, posted 'Tigrin (V)'); Lobot (V) x8, Computer Interface (V) x19 (VS6; for Computer Interface, ovs_pick returned a VS7+ printing (sets 7+ default to legal from 2004-06-01); used the latest VS1-6 printing instead).

Posted 'Kal’ Fal' dested Kal'Falnl C'ndros; 'Hoth: 4th marker' Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker); 'Hoth: Generatiors' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker); 'Cloud City: Docking Bay' Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay).
